producer_report.summary: The drain no longer asks GitHub to merge while any check run on the pull request head is unfinished. A merge refused with 'Repository rule violations' while checks are pending is now a wait, not a failure. Root cause: classify_checks judged only the required `fmt, clippy, tests` run, so an in-progress optional run read Green and the merge was requested early; the drain then counted the refusal as a failed landing and stopped the run. classify_checks now returns Pending while any run has a status other than completed. A failed required run is still Red, and a failed optional run is still only a note. In land_pr, a 'Repository rule violations' refusal is followed by one re-read of the checks. If they are pending, it returns Ok with checks Pending, merge_requested true and a 'waiting to merge' warning. Otherwise the original error is returned. In the drain, I added Landing::Waiting and ItemEnd::Waiting. A waiting job is shown as 'waiting to merge: ...', is not retried, is not counted as a failure, and the run goes on to the next job. PrLander now maps its result through a small pure function, landing_from_report. display.rs shows a refused merge with pending checks as 'waiting to merge'. The doc comments are updated and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. New tests cover each part in gh, drain and display.

The wait path leaves the landing-intent record written before the refused merge. The warning names it, and the existing reconciliation handles an unconfirmed merge.

As the plan noted: dependents of a waiting item can still start, because take_until_done marks the item done whatever its end. An optional check that never finishes leaves the job reported as 'waiting to merge' on every run. I added no time limit.
Check-run statuses other than completed (queued, in_progress, waiting, requested, pending) all count as unfinished.

learnings: classify_checks decided only on the required CI_AGGREGATE_JOB run, so an in-progress optional run read Green and the merge was requested early. That is the root cause.
PrHost::check_report has a default that wraps checks(). FakeHost now overrides it to call the production classify_checks when its `runs` field is set.
Drain::land returned a bool, and the attempts loop counted every false as a failed attempt. Two such failures end the run as RepeatedFailure.
PrReport has no waiting field. A wait is state Open with checks Some(Pending).
